label: Late 4th downs: go / FG / punt
pattern: punt instead of go for it

label: Offense stopping the clock (timeout / spike / hurry)
pattern: timeout instead of hurry to the line

label: Defensive timeouts (trailing late / before half)
pattern: timeout instead of let clock run

label: End of 1st half: attack vs. run it out
pattern: attack instead of run out the half

label: Late PAT: kick vs. two
pattern: kick PAT instead of go for two

label: Leading offense burning play clock
pattern: snapped early instead of milk play clock

label: Kneel-down when the game can be iced
pattern: run a play instead of kneel
